risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (243.36) indicates extreme market stress, CPI event in 1 day adds binary risk, and utilities face credit spread pressure in tightening environment.

debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI 87+, Stoch 92+), below-average volume, inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, CPI event in 1 day, and zero fundamental/smart money conviction create unacceptable reversal and macro risk.
